claims: The Artemis I Orion spacecraft splashed down in the Pacific Ocean on December 11, 2022.
The splashdown was west of Baja California near Guadalupe Island.
The Artemis I Orion spacecraft touched down at 9:40 a.m. PST.
9:40 a.m. PST is equivalent to 12:40 p.m. EST.
The mission was around the Moon.
The mission goal was final testing of the heat shield.
The heat shield handled temperatures of nearly 5,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
The USS Portland retrieved the Artemis I Orion spacecraft following the splashdown.
The retrieval concluded the maiden flight of the Artemis program
